system: Yakıt & Hava Ölçümü (MAF, MAP, O2, ECT Sensörleri)
symptoms: Engine runs rough, missing or stumbling
Blows black smoke from tail pipe
The oxygen sensor is typically located upstream of the catalytic converter.
Bank 2 refers to the side of the engine that does not contain cylinder #1 in V-type engines.
